records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales generated in the three months ended March 26, 2023 decreased $74.8 million, or 1.8%, from net sales generated in the three months ended March 27, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the first quarter of 2023, Ukraine grain export volumes continued to recover, but still remain below pre-war volumes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cold storage inventories, which ended 2022 at 7% above the 5-year average, declined by 8.3% from prior year-end levels as of the end of March 2023 and are now near the 5-year average.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated a consolidated operating margin of 0.8%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income decreased by $370.7 million, or 92.2%, from income of $402.0 million generated in the three months ended March 27, 2022 to income of $31.3 million generated in the three months ended March 26, 2023.
